bounds: Two owner-reply scans evaluate one fired task whose completion check passes and whose pipeline.onComplete holds one child. Each scan reads the row and then commits; a commit records the completed log row and creates the child in one step. The six generated read/commit interleavings are replayed through the production runner with the real user_replied_within check, in-memory stores and pipeline scheduling. A snooze between a scan's read and its commit is a separate test in runner-completion-settle.test.ts; a failing completion check, other verbs under the host mutation policy, and the SQL store's conditional write keep their existing coverage.
